description: This file defines an abstract class 'CallExpression' within the Twig templating engine, handling the compilation of callable expressions, argument processing, and reflection for dynamic method invocation.

classes.name: CallExpression
classes.description: An abstract class in Twig for handling the compilation of function or method call expressions within templates, including argument handling and reflection.

methods.name: compileCallable
methods.description: Compiles the callable part of the expression, resolving the correct method or function to invoke based on the callable's type and context.

methods.name: compileArguments
methods.description: Generates code for the arguments passed to the callable, including environment, context, charset, and user-defined arguments.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Deprecated method for extracting arguments; now recommends using Twig\Util\CallableArgumentsExtractor::getArguments().

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Deprecated method for normalizing argument names to lowercase with underscores.

methods.name: getCallableParameters
methods.description: Uses reflection to determine the parameters of a callable, accounting for special Twig arguments and variadic parameters.

methods.name: reflectCallable
methods.description: Creates or returns a ReflectionCallable object for inspecting callables.

methods.name: getTwigCallable
methods.description: Overrides the Twig callable based on node attributes, supporting different types like 'test', 'function', 'filter'.
